summary: install_stick_test.sh on i686, on an install stick made by the rule of a private copy of mk/images.mk from this tree's recovery ISO, a sealed disk and the installer root

argv: tag=; [ ! -f krffs/recovery_authorized_keys ] || tag=-with-key; make -s -j8 rach2 build/images/installer-root.ext2 rach2-recovery-image build/tests/system/harness build/tests/system/runutil build/tools/image/mkmbr build/tools/image/fatchains build/tools/image/grubembed build/tools/image/stickcheck build/tests/host/mkexfatfixture ARCH=i686 </dev/null && make -s build/images/rach2-recovery$tag.iso ARCH=i686 </dev/null && rm -rf ${WORK}/input ${WORK}/images ${WORK}/stick.img && mkdir -p ${WORK}/input ${WORK}/images && cp build/images/installer-root.ext2 ${WORK}/input/rach2-metal-disk.ext2 && RACH2_DISK_BOOT_MB=64 RACH2_DISK_CLUSTER=8 RACH2_DISK_RECOVERY_MB=64 RACH2_DISK_RECOVERY_KERNEL=build/rach2-recovery/kernel RACH2_DISK_RECOVERY_IMAGE=build/images/rach2-recovery$tag.krffs RACH2_DISK_EXT2_MB=64 RACH2_DISK_EXT2_IMAGE=${WORK}/input/rach2-metal-disk.ext2 sh tools/image/mkdisk_grub.sh build/rach2/kernel ${WORK}/input/rach2-sealed.disk </dev/null && printf '%s\n' 'IMAGES_DIR = ${WORK}/images' "RECOVERY_KEY_TAG = $tag" "RECOVERY_ISO = build/images/rach2-recovery$tag.iso" 'SEALED_DISK = ${WORK}/input/rach2-sealed.disk' 'SEALED_EXT2 = ${WORK}/input/rach2-metal-disk.ext2' 'MKEXFATFIXTURE = build/tests/host/mkexfatfixture' 'MKMBR = build/tools/image/mkmbr' 'STICKCHECK = build/tools/image/stickcheck' 'FATCHAINS = build/tools/image/fatchains' 'GRUBEMBED = build/tools/image/grubembed' 'include ${SRC}/mk/images.mk' >${WORK}/Makefile && make -s -f ${WORK}/Makefile rach2-install-stick ARCH=i686 </dev/null && mv ${WORK}/images/rach2-install-stick$tag.img ${WORK}/stick.img

faults.name: root
faults.summary: the stick is made with no root image, which the test must report as missing

faults.name: reserve
faults.summary: the stick's volume has 4 MiB of free space in place of 256, too little for the saved partitions
